name: Tumerok Tower (15.6N, 49.9W)
title: 15.6N, 49.9W - Tumerok Tower
summary: A lone Tumerok-held spire tower on a sandy beach at the foot of a 220 m sea cliff on the Northern Landbridge coast, near Fort Tethana (acpedia: once a lich tower, taken over by Tumeroks, possibly when the Viamontians took the Tumerok fortification on the mountain top). The kit shows a 31 m five-story spire tower (0x01001117) at the waterline with three glowing fire pits and a 20 m rock pillar beside it, shallow sea to the east and south, and the 16.5N 50.5W Tumerok Fortification (spire towers, flag poles and walls) on the cliff top 220 m above to the north-west.

site.name: Tumerok Tower (15.6N, 49.9W)
site.notes: Derived @teleloc on the beach sand at (12470,28180), ground 0.3, 15.7 m from the nearest spawn, not water. The gazetteer has only a map @tele for this POI.

insertNote: Kept the batch's route position (danbys-outpost -> fort-tethana).

shots.standingOrder: Skim north-west 3 m above the shallow sea toward the beach tower with the 220 m cliff rising behind it; stay over open water and stop 65 m short of the tower.
shots.notes: Water: the lens skims 3 m above the shallow sea (100% of samples over WaterShallowSea, z 0) for 80 m north-west at 8 m/s toward the 31 m Tumerok spire tower on the beach. The gimbal is tilted up 11 deg so the 220 m sea cliff behind the tower fills the upper frame (cliff top at ndc y 0.75-0.92) while the tower grows from the centre. The high noon sun is behind the left shoulder and lights the tower's sea face. The path ends 67 m short of the tower. shots.standingOrder: Start hidden behind the 20 m rock pillar at the foot of the cliff, then truck right toward the surf until the Tumerok tower and its fire pits stand clear; keep 3 m from the rock and never fade it.
shots.notes: Reveal: the lens starts 3 m west of a 20 m rock pillar (GfxObj 0x01000F9F, 7 x 6 m) at the foot of the cliff, which hides the tower completely. It holds, then trucks 14 m south-south-west toward the surf until the tower and its three glowing fire pits stand clear on the beach. LOS is clear from about t 4 s, inside the edit window. The noon sun from the south side-lights the tower. The pillar is the occluder by design and must not be faded.
